sources.title: The 7 A Framework for Effective Content Marketing

concepts.definition: A site on your own domain where you bring the audience that first finds you on platforms you do not control.
Unplanned opportunities such as partnerships that content creates.

questions.q: List the seven A's of the framework.
questions.a: Agile, authentic, attention, audience, authority, action, acceleration.

questions.q: What does authenticity mean in the 7A framework, and what does it not mean?
questions.a: It means a genuine voice consistent with your values, not oversharing personal details.
